title: GenderBench: Evaluation Suite for Gender Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: A comprehensive evaluation suite (GenderBench) containing 14 probes that measure outcome disparities (e.g., counterfactual gender/name substitution in high-stakes decisions like hiring, loan approvals, and healthcare), stereotypical reasoning (e.g., multiple-choice stereotype association tests, vocabulary analysis in generated business communications), and representational harms (e.g., evaluating pronoun usage and gender balance in open-ended creative text generation).
